title: RavenEpigraphs
description: What the Raven's epigraphs do (Raven Epigraph page): the text of each epigraph in each plan with the numbers it shows at every promotion level and for every Raven Evolve boost. The epigraphs themselves are the items `<epigraph>_iv_<faction>` of pack_data.json (their names, pictures, rarity), referenced by those ids.

evolve_boost_levels.description: The Raven Evolve levels at which the boost of its bonus rises by one: below the first the boost is 0, from the first it is 1, and so on. A boost's bonus numbers are `bonus_values` at the index of the boost.

evolve_max_level.description: The highest Raven Evolve level the page takes.

plan_unlock_levels.description: The Raven Evolve level each plan (the Raven's epigraph plans I, II and III) unlocks at. A plan that isn't unlocked yet is greyed out and doesn't count in the answer.

epigraphs.description: By epigraph (`frenzied_flock`, `protective_charm`, `reversal_power`, `guard_of_nature`), then by plan (`warrior`, `ranger`, `warlock`). An epigraph or plan without an entry shows no text yet.

description.description: What the epigraph does, as the game words it. A {placeholder} (with a "+" right before it and a "%" right after it where the number has them) is a number: its name is a key of `values` (it depends on the promotion level) or of `bonus_values` (it depends on the Raven Evolve boost).

values.description: The numbers by promotion level: per placeholder one list with the entry for promotion level n at index n (7 entries, level 0 to 6), null where the number isn't known yet (shown as ?); or one number for what doesn't depend on the level.

bonus_values.description: The bonus numbers by Raven Evolve boost: per placeholder one list with the entry for boost n at index n (one more entry than `evolve_boost_levels`: boost 0 first, usually 0 which the page leaves out), null where the number isn't known yet.
